title: Sheaf derivations preserving specified point ideals
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $E\subseteq |X|$ a set of points. Write $d:\mathcal O_X\to\Omega^1_{X/S}$ for the universal relative derivation [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf]. A relative vector field is represented by an $\mathcal O_X$-linear morphism $\theta:\Omega^1_{X/S}\to\mathcal O_X$, corresponding to the sheaf derivation $D=\theta\circ d$. For a point $x\in X$ and an open neighbourhood $U$, let $\operatorname{ev}_{U,x}:\mathcal O_X(U)\to\kappa(x)$ be germ followed by the residue map [def-weil-residue-field]. Define $\operatorname{Der}(f;E)$ to be the additive subgroup of these morphisms for which $\operatorname{ev}_{U,x}(D(a))=0$ whenever $x\in E$, $U$ contains $x$, and $a\in\ker(\operatorname{ev}_{U,x})$. Equivalently, $D$ preserves every specified point ideal. For closed points this is the ideal-sheaf preservation condition. The evaluation homomorphism on vector fields is $\theta\mapsto\operatorname{ev}_{U,x}(\theta(d a))$.
